ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Creates a page anchor for direct links to this section. Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

SectionTitle.helper: Optional. The main heading displayed above the cards. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render as entered.

SectionDescription.helper: Required. Introduce this group of cards in one or two short sentences. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render as entered.
SectionDescription.placeholder: Explain the shared benefit these cards help visitors understand.

Cards.label: Cards
Cards.helper: Add as many cards as needed. Only the first three cards are displayed on the website.

Title.helper: Required. Add a short, clear heading for this card. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render as entered.
Title.placeholder: Help customers find the right choice

Description.helper: Required. Briefly explain this benefit. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render as entered.
Description.placeholder: Organize your offerings so customers can quickly find what they need.

Icon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

IconColor.helper: Choose the icon color from the available options.

CardLink.helper: Optional. Select a local page or enter a complete http or https web addresses. When provided, the whole card becomes a link and displays Learn More.

SectionFooter.helper: Optional. Add a short note below the cards. Formatted text and links are allowed and will render as entered.
SectionFooter.placeholder: Choose a benefit to learn more.
